extracted.intended_audience: scientists, naturalists, teachers, students, and purchasers of scientific books/instruments
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts evaluative standards and practical requirements for scientific textbooks, field-identification guides, chemical/industrial formulations, and scientific apparatus as discussed in book reviews and advertisements. Focuses on what makes these works/devices fit-for-purpose for teaching, field use, or industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficient denaturant requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: An efficient denaturant must: (1) render the spirit nauseous, even when used in comparatively small quantity; (2) not be capable of being easily removed by distillation or by mechanical or chemical treatment; (3) be capable of ready and certain detection, even if present in very small quantity; and (4) not affect the industrial value of the spirit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ideal denaturant has not yet been found; the method suggested by Mr. George Phillips (adding wood-naphtha or crude methyl alcohol containing associated pyroligneous products) has in practice been found the most convenient and suitable.

rubrics_metrics.name: All-round lens performance (portrait/wide-angle)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each lens will give perfect definition with full aperture to the extreme corners of the plate it is sold to cover; with smaller stops it will cover at least two sizes larger, giving perfect sharpness all over the plate and thus becoming a wide-angle lens of the highest excellence. Either combination may be used separately, giving foci of about and 2 times the length of that of the lens when used intact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Being equivalent to four lenses at the price of one, the combination permits choosing the best point of view irrespective of distance—an advantage for the artistic worker.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field identification key design for pocket guides
rubrics_metrics.description: A pocket key devised 'for the observer with a field-glass' deals with habitat, flight, and characteristic habits rather than details of plumage; it is in two parts — an index (first part) under seven locality headings with two columns for winter and summer listing species likely to be seen, and a second part with short descriptions of about one hundred common species.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By dividing lists into groups according to size and adding a two-word description of each species, the key aims to reduce possibilities to two or three species, with page references to the descriptive part for final identification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handbook approach to field identification (concise, situational arrangement)
rubrics_metrics.description: A handbook (not a key) describes the bird 'as it catches the eye' at a distance and close at hand — its general colour, shape, peculiarities of motion and cry — and is arranged according to the circumstances under which species are likely to be first met (grouped by locality and subdivided for summer and winter). Descriptions are cut short to facilitate identification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes concise accounts of general life habits and nesting, directions for encouraging desirable birds and rearing orphaned young, and an enumerated, briefly diagnosed list of natural families to give readers some idea of classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Illustration quality standards for identification works
rubrics_metrics.description: Coloured plates may receive highest praise; many black-and-white illustrations can be interesting and novel; but photographs of captive birds, stuffed groups, and some field photographs may not aid identification and can be 'not always so happy'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Good coloured plates and numerous good bird-pictures at low cost are valuable; care is needed when using photographs of captive or stuffed birds for identification purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical experiment design in plant-biology textbooks
rubrics_metrics.description: Study of physiology and ecology should be by continuous observation and experiment; the experiments 'are not theoretical inventions' and 'each one has been carefully worked by undergraduates under the supervision of the author.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Necessary materials and apparatus should be obtainable at trivial cost so experiments are within reach of all; textbooks should emphasize practicable experiments rather than purely theoretical treatments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical physics textbook suitability for schools and colleges
rubrics_metrics.description: A full and sensible course of practical work in physics intended for use in secondary schools, technical schools and colleges; authors should be 'evidently familiar with the difficulties experienced by learners' and the book should give students opportunity of doing excellent work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text should be of good quality throughout and provide practical exercises and instruction matched to the educational level (useful addition to existing literature).

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical electricity textbook objectives and pedagogy
rubrics_metrics.description: The object is to give the student a thorough acquaintance with the elements of Practical Electrical Engineering, and to base the knowledge from the outset on sound scientific principles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book should be prepared in accordance with the most modern ideas regarding technical education and be of considerable value as a textbook for secondary schools, technical schools, and university colleges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Textbook clarity, problem selection, and illustrative material
rubrics_metrics.description: A useful text-book should be clearly written and illustrated (e.g., by line drawings); the selection of problems should be well made and the treatment clear and suitable for intended classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples and problems should be arranged to illustrate methods; preference is given to propositions/exercises which retain most value in the text; alternative proofs and explanations may be provided where pedagogically helpful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pedagogical organization to meet examination/syllabus requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Textbooks should be arranged to meet the requirements of examination syllabuses (e.g., Board of Education), with material divided into logical books/parts (triangles, areas, circle, proportion etc.) and worked examples at points to illustrate methods of solving geometrical exercises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where possible, use discarded theorems of Euclid or alternative approaches to provide propositions that are short in value; supplemental material (e.g., answers or separate parts) may be offered to suit teaching needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Features of high-class technical treatises
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical treatises (e.g., on manufacture of sulphuric acid and alkali) should offer theoretical and practical treatment, be available in thorough multi-volume editions, contain numerous working drawings and illustrations 'drawn to scale', and be revised/extended in enlarged editions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive coverage, detailed working drawings, and up-to-date revisions are signs of utility and reliability for professional and advanced-student audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apparatus construction and teaching suitability (student resistance box)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sets made specially for teaching should allow students to see all coils and connections (e.g., thick glass cylinder, sawlite top, heavy blocks, well-fitting plugs, mahogany base); coils adjusted across a practical resistance range (from ~1 ohm to 100 ohms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Construction should be robust and transparent for pedagogical demonstration; descriptive leaflets and specification should be available on application so teachers can assess fit-for-purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Camera and instrument manufacture criteria for field/naturalist use
rubrics_metrics.description: Cameras and reflex outfits marketed for naturalists/telephoto work should emphasize pre-quality, precision, durability, and simplicity; specialized reflex outfits for naturalists and telephoto work, full English manufacture, and provision of necessary movements and fittings are desirable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manufacturers promote features (double blockform backs, Bausch & Lomb lenses, shutter types, measurement of focal lengths and plate sizes) and price/catalogue details to help purchasers choose appropriate equipment.
